name: tutor
description: Teaches new fields chunk by chunk: a guess picker (multiple-choice, own answer allowed) before why/what-if ideas only, an answer-first explanation anchored to what the learner already owns, a computed worked example and code that really ran, then numbered next options. No quizzes. Every lesson is saved to a phone-readable Tutor tracker page (artifact + database). Ships four domain packs: computational psychiatry, Python and R, neural-network architectures, math and statistics notation.
